result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21. INS (P01308): expressed by pancreatic beta cells; decreases blood glucose. GCG (P01275): glucagon is secreted by A cells of the islets, raises plasma glucose and activates GCGR, which couples to Gs and raises cAMP; glucagon release is stimulated by hypoglycaemia and inhibited by hyperglycaemia, insulin and somatostatin; in intestinal L cells PCSK1 releases GLP-1, a potent stimulator of glucose-dependent insulin release that suppresses plasma glucagon. INSR (P06213): receptor tyrosine kinase; PI3K generates PIP3, a lipid second messenger that activates PDPK1 and then AKT; the net effect is translocation of GLUT4 from cytoplasmic vesicles to the cell membrane. GCGR (P47871), GLP1R (P43220) and TSHR (P16473): G-protein-coupled receptors that activate adenylyl cyclase; TSHR couples to Gs, and PKA phosphorylates thyroid peroxidase and the sodium/iodide symporter. ADRB1 (P08588): couples to Gs to activate adenylyl cyclase and stimulates cardiomyocyte contraction. GHSR (Q92847): ghrelin receptor coupled to Gq that modulates phospholipase C and mediates production of diacylglycerol and inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate. PLCB1 (Q9NQ66): hydrolyses phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate into diacylglycerol and inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate and signals downstream of G-protein-coupled receptors; PLCB3 (Q01970) is activated by G(q) and G(11) G alpha proteins downstream of such receptors. ITPR1 (Q14643): inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate-gated channel that releases calcium from the endoplasmic reticulum. THRB (P10828): nuclear hormone receptor and transcriptional repressor or activator with high affinity for T3 and T4. LEPR (P48357): type I cytokine receptor that signals through JAK2 and STAT3. LEP (P41159): adipose tissue is the main source; in the hypothalamus it decreases food intake and increases energy consumption; leptin deficiency causes severe hyperphagia and intractable obesity from an early age, and leptin receptor deficiency hyperphagia and severe obesity from an early age with normal serum leptin. GHRL (Q9UBU3): highest expression in stomach; ghrelin stimulates appetite and growth hormone release, and octanoylation, by GOAT/MBOAT4 (Q96T53), is essential for activation of GHSR. Thyroid pathway entries: SLC5A5 (Q92911) moves iodide into the thyroid with 2 Na+, is inhibited by perchlorate and up-regulated by thyrotropin; TPO (P07202), with haem b and H2O2 from DUOX2 (Q9NRD8), iodinates thyroglobulin tyrosines and couples two diiodotyrosines to thyroxine, leaving dehydroalanine; TG (P01266) is iodinated and coupled in the follicle lumen and cleaved by cathepsins B, L and K in the lumen and after endocytosis; DIO1 (P49895) and DIO2 (Q92813) convert T4 to T3 by outer-ring deiodination; DIO3 (P55073) converts T3 to 3,3'-diiodothyronine and T4 to reverse T3 by inner-ring deiodination.
